=== CHARACTER COUNT ===

There are TWO important characters:

1. Riven
2. Ally Soldier

There is exactly ONE Riven.

There is exactly ONE Ally Soldier.

All other visible humans are ordinary SOLDIERS.

There is a VERY LARGE ARMY.

DOZENS OF SOLDIERS are visible.

This is NOT a small squad or patrol.

The army fills the mountain road and extends far into the background.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

Use the provided ROAD TO HOME VILLAGE reference as the environment reference.

The entire video takes place on this mountain road.

It is sunset.

Warm fading sunset light covers the mountain landscape.

The road is crowded with a large military force.

No location change.

No burning village.

No monsters.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Fast, intense, readable medieval combat.

Realistic human anatomy.

Realistic sword weight and physical impact.

Natural armor, cloth, hair, dust, and environmental physics.

Dynamic cinematic camera movement.

The action should feel chaotic and dangerous while remaining visually understandable.

Keep the army large and active throughout the video.

No dialogue.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No text.

No watermark.

No logo.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Riven is already standing on the mountain road with her large sword drawn.

A VERY LARGE ARMY surrounds the area.

DOZENS OF SOLDIERS are visible across the road.

Several SOLDIERS suddenly rush directly toward Riven and attack her.

Riven immediately fights back.

The confrontation rapidly erupts into chaotic combat.

More SOLDIERS react and rush toward the fight.

Other groups of SOLDIERS continue moving farther down the road toward the village.

Riven is extremely skilled and initially overwhelms the soldiers attacking her.

Ally Soldier stays outside the immediate fight.

He watches what is happening but does NOT join either side.

He does NOT draw his weapon.


=== SCENE ===

Begin immediately with Riven already standing in the middle of the crowded mountain road.

Her large sword is already drawn.

A huge military force surrounds the area.

DOZENS OF SOLDIERS fill the road in front of her, behind her, and deep into the background.

Ally Soldier is nearby but outside the immediate confrontation.

Several SOLDIERS suddenly rush directly at Riven and attack.

Riven reacts immediately.

Combat erupts.

Riven fights back with fast, powerful, highly skilled heavy-sword combat.

Keep the fighting fluid and natural.

Do not mechanically choreograph every individual sword strike.

Riven blocks incoming attacks, counters aggressively, drives soldiers backward, and knocks attackers down as she moves through the immediate fight.

The first attackers struggle against Riven's superior skill.

But the situation rapidly becomes more chaotic.

More SOLDIERS rush toward Riven from different directions.

Weapons clash.

Soldiers move rapidly around the road.

Armor collides.

Boots strike the dirt.

Dust rises into the sunset light.

The military formation breaks apart around the confrontation.

Keep the entire environment alive with movement.

Some SOLDIERS attack Riven.

Some SOLDIERS rush around the confrontation.

Some groups continue moving farther down the road toward the village.

DOZENS OF SOLDIERS remain visible throughout the action.

Do not isolate Riven.

Do not create an empty circle around her.

Do not reduce the army to only a few attackers.

The road must remain crowded, active, and chaotic.

Riven continues fighting the soldiers directly attacking her.

She successfully drives back the first wave.

Several attackers fall or are forced away from her.

Riven gains a brief opening in the chaos.

She looks farther down the road.

A substantial part of the army is still moving toward her home.

Riven realizes the army is continuing forward despite the fight.

More SOLDIERS begin closing in on her again.

Ally Soldier remains outside the immediate combat.

He watches Riven fighting against their own soldiers.

He is shocked and conflicted.

Ally Soldier does NOT fight Riven.

Ally Soldier does NOT fight the SOLDIERS.

Ally Soldier does NOT draw his weapon.

End with Riven surrounded by the chaotic movement of the large army.

Her sword remains ready.

Another larger group of SOLDIERS is beginning to close in on her.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Riven is still standing and still holding her sword.

The first attackers have been driven back.

The confrontation has become a large chaotic internal fight.

DOZENS OF SOLDIERS remain visible.

More SOLDIERS are closing in on Riven.

A substantial part of the army is still moving farther down the road toward the village.

The army has NOT been defeated.

The road remains crowded.

Ally Soldier has NOT joined the fight.

Ally Soldier has NOT drawn his weapon.


=== MOOD ===

Chaotic.

Violent.

Urgent.

Large-scale.

Cinematic.

Riven is skilled, focused, and decisive.

She is not enjoying the fight.

Ally Soldier is shocked and conflicted.

The key visual idea is:

A HUGE ARMY FILLS THE ROAD.

SOLDIERS ATTACK RIVEN.

RIVEN FIGHTS BACK.

THE ROAD ERUPTS INTO CHAOS.

PART OF THE ARMY CONTINUES TOWARD THE VILLAGE.

MORE SOLDIERS CLOSE IN ON RIVEN.

CUT.、16:9
